executive_summary.primary_bottleneck: High monthly churn (8.5%) and low net revenue retention (88%)
key_findings: Churn erodes growth faster than acquisition
executive_summary.strategic_thesis: Deploy repeatable retention and activation systems to curb churn while using founder‑led LinkedIn outreach for steady acquisition
executive_summary.primary_30_day_objective: Reduce monthly churn by 2 percentage points and increase activation rate of new users by 20%
assumptions: Founder can lead outbound LinkedIn efforts
No‑code email and in‑app tools are available
Team of 3 can execute without dedicated engineers

prioritized_growth_channels.leading_kpi: Email open rate for at‑risk cohort
